title: Books
page_description:
Peer-reviewed. Openly licensed. 100% free.

And backed by additional learning resources. Review our OpenStax textbooks and decide if they are right for your course. Simple to adopt, free to use. We make it easy to improve student access to education materials in K12 and higher education.
dev_standard_1_description: Our open source textbooks are written by professional content developers who are experts in their fields.
dev_standard_2_description: All textbooks meet standard scope and sequence requirements, making them seamlessly adaptable into existing courses.
dev_standard_3_description: OpenStax textbooks undergo a rigorous peer review process. You can view the list of contributors when you click on each book.
dev_standard_4_description: With philanthropic support, our books have helped 43.4 million students save $3.4 billion in educational costs since 2012. Learn more about our impact and how you can help.

value.name: Assignable
value.description:
Power up your OpenStax experience with Assignable!

OpenStax Assignable is our official teaching and learning platform! This affordable tool lets you assign customized assessments, readings, and activities directly within your LMS, including Blackboard, Canvas, D2L Brightspace, Moodle, and Schoology. OpenStax Assignable is designed to boost student success and save you time with features like auto-grading, instant feedback, and LMS grade sync. Learn more here!

value.name: Art In Neuroscience
value.description:
Announcing the 2026 Art in Neuroscience Competition

The editorial team for Introduction to Behavioral Neuroscience is inviting student submissions for the second Art in Neuroscience competition. We are open to any type of original art related to neuroscience, in any form that students can submit digitally.


The top 3 pieces will be announced and published on the Introduction to Behavioral Neuroscience textbook website, as well as on associated social media accounts.

Submissions open 1 September 2026

Submissions close 1 November 2026

Submit your art by completing this form.


To see previous winners, view the document.

value.name: Staxly
value.description:
Staxly, our new AI study coach, is here to support your economics journey.

Staxly is free and available 24/7 to help you learn and better understand the subject, simplify a concept, and generate relevant examples and explanations, adapting to your needs and where you are in your learning. To access it, simply log in to your OpenStax account, and begin your learning experience with Staxly.
